title: attest init --json
description: Files `attest init` (Python and TypeScript SDK CLIs) wrote or left alone in the project root. Paths are relative to the project root, use forward slashes and are sorted. With --skills, the agent skills from `attest-engine skills install` are included: its created and updated paths as created and updated, its unchanged paths as skipped. With --mcp, the client configs from `attest-engine mcp install` are included the same way: its created and updated paths, and its unchanged paths as skipped. Its conflict paths (a config already holding a different attest entry, left as it is) are listed under conflict, a key present only with --mcp.

created.description: Files that did not exist and were written.

conflict.description: With --mcp: client configs that already hold a different attest entry and were left as they are. Absent without --mcp.
